question: What does one-pointed meditation make in many forms?
premises: kurute bahudhā rūpaṃ means makes form in many ways
dhyāna eka gata cetasaḥ means mind gone to one-pointed meditation
inference: One whose mind has gone to one-pointed meditation makes form in many ways.
uncertainties: whether kurute is reflexive or general
plain_english: One whose mind is absorbed in one-pointed meditation makes form in many ways.
